request.style: English, gospel, powerful soulful female lead vocal, full gospel choir with call and response, Hammond B3 organ, gospel piano, electric bass, drums and hand claps, 12/8 feel, uplifting, building to a triumphant final chorus, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was wandering in the valley, lost and low
Carrying a burden that I couldn't let go
Then I heard a promise from an old worn page
Words that broke the chains and opened up the cage

[Chorus]
For God so loved the world
That He gave His only begotten Son
That whosoever believeth in Him
Should not perish, but have everlasting life

[Verse]
Mama sang it softly when the night was long
Grandpa hummed it working, made the weary strong
Not a single soul is standing out of reach
Love so wide and deep that only grace can teach

[Chorus]
For God so loved the world
That He gave His only begotten Son
That whosoever believeth in Him
Should not perish, but have everlasting life

[Bridge]
Whosoever, that means you
Whosoever, that means me
Whosoever, lift your voice
Sing it out and be set free

[Chorus]
For God so loved the world
That He gave His only begotten Son
That whosoever believeth in Him
Should not perish, but have everlasting life

[Outro]
Everlasting life, everlasting life
John three sixteen, everlasting life
